@multiRename.mediaField.exifIso.sameAsSourceJustification: ISO is the international name of the sensitivity setting; the pile’s Dolphin writes “Vitesse ISO”, keeping ISO as is.

@multiRename.mediaField.exifOrientation.sameAsSourceJustification: French “Orientation” is spelled the same; the pile’s file managers use “Orientation”.

@multiRename.mediaField.tagAlbum.sameAsSourceJustification: French “Album” is spelled the same; the pile’s file managers label the music field “Album”.

@multiRename.mediaField.tagGenre.sameAsSourceJustification: French “Genre” is spelled the same; the pile’s file managers label the music field “Genre”.
